## Intro

-   Question:

    -   What if urban environments are not the preview of future warming? Different responses (sensitivity). therefore, we cannot assume species will respond similarly and make comparison.

    -   Other studies based on buffer zones/remote sensing (without distinguishing species) suggest that sensitivity may decrease in urban areas. ([Yang et al., 2023](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1111/gcb.16761)) This is due to other urbanizing factors.

    -   Use Acer as an example. Plan to expand to other genera.
    
    -  Scale; 


Yang: 

current: 
urban settings have been regarded as "open laboratories"
compared to their rural counterparts based on urban–rural comparisons and/or the urban–rural gradient analysis
the sensitivity o towards temperature, impacted by other factors (distinct anthropogenic influences)


Their question:
whether phenological responses to spatial temperature rise in urban settings can substitute for those to temporal temperature rise in their natural counterparts

rural -> urban: spatial
natural: temporal 

Their methods:

slope_P_time/slope_LST_time
slope_P_UI/slope_LST_UI

urban-time
urban-space
natural-time

The thresholds of ~11°C mean annual temperature and ~600 mm annual precipitation differentiated the magnitude of spatial and temporal SOS and EOS sensitivity to temperature. Below those thresholds, a stronger advanced spring phenology and delayed autumn phenology across the spatial urbanization gradients than those through time occurred, and vice versa.

?
if UI 大于0 没有足够的植被代表?

Improve:

different cities: develop tractories
rural -> urban: warming tractories

```{r}
metadata <- read_csv("~/lab-data/datasets/vegetation/PS/urban/metadata.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(site == !!city)

file_list <- list.files(path = "~/lab-data/datasets/vegetation/PS/urban/doy", pattern = paste0("^doy_",city,"_", genus), full.names = TRUE)

data_list <- file_list %>%
  map(~ readRDS(.x))
all_doy <- bind_rows(data_list)

urban_tree_ph <- metadata %>%
  mutate(genus = str_extract(taxa, "^[^ ]+")) %>%
  left_join(all_doy, by = "id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(doy))

urban_tree_location <- urban_tree_ph %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)
```

Use SOS (0.5, up) for spring phenology

#### Urban

```{r}
urban_tree_sos <- urban_tree_ph %>%
  filter(direction == "up" & thres == 0.5)

neon_tree_sos <- neon_tree_ph %>%
  filter(direction == "up" & thres == 0.5)

nyc_trees <- urban_tree_sos %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  slice(1)

all_point_result <- NULL

for (row in 1805:nrow(nyc_trees)) {
  cat("Processing row:", row, "out of ", nrow(nyc_trees), "\n")
  point <- nyc_trees[row,]
  
  years_for_id <- urban_tree_sos %>%
    filter(id == point$id) %>%
    pull(year)
  years_for_id <- unique(c(years_for_id, min(years_for_id) - 1))
  year_pattern <- paste(years_for_id, collapse = "|")
  coord_vect <- vect(data.frame(lon = point$lon, lat = point$lat), crs = "EPSG:4326")
  folder.raw <- paste0("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/Daymet/daily2016-2024")
  
  mean_result <- NULL
  
  for (variable in c("prcp","srad","tmax","tmin")) {
    pattern <- paste0(variable, "_daily_(", year_pattern, ")_ncss\\.nc$")
    file_list <- list.files(folder.raw, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
    var_result <- NULL
    for (file in file_list){
        clim_nc <- terra::rast(file)
        extracted_values <- suppressWarnings(terra::extract(clim_nc, coord_vect)) %>%
          dplyr::select(-ID)
        colnames(extracted_values) <- as.character(clim_nc@ptr[["time"]])
        
        temp_result <- cbind(point["id"], extracted_values) %>%
          pivot_longer(
            cols = -id,
            names_to = "time",
            values_to = variable
          ) %>%
          mutate(
            date = as.Date(as.POSIXct(as.numeric(time), origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC"))
          ) %>%
          select(-time) 
        
        var_result <- bind_rows(var_result, temp_result)
        
    }
        
    mean_result <- bind_cols(mean_result, var_result)
  # %>%
  #   mutate(id = point$id, year = point$year)
  }
  all_point_result <- bind_rows(all_point_result, mean_result)
}


#################################################################

all_point_result <- all_point_result %>%
  mutate(id = id...1, date = date...3) %>%
  select(id, date, prcp, srad, tmin, tmax)

nyc_mean_doy <- mean(urban_tree_sos$doy)

pre_lengths <- seq(5, 180, by = 5)

for (batch_idx in 1:num_batches) {

    mutate(
      start_date = make_date(year) + days(round(nyc_mean_doy) - 1) - days(preseason_length),
      end_date = make_date(year) + days(round(nyc_mean_doy) - 1)
    )

  batch_min_date <- min(urban_tree_sos_batch$start_date)
  batch_max_date <- max(urban_tree_sos_batch$end_date)
  
  all_point_filtered_batch <- all_point_filtered %>%
    filter(date >= batch_min_date & date <= batch_max_date)

  batch_result <- urban_tree_sos_batch %>%
    inner_join(all_point_filtered_batch, by = "id") %>%
    filter(date >= start_date & date <= end_date) %>%
    group_by(id, year, preseason_length) %>%
    summarise(
      tmin_mean = mean(tmin, na.rm = TRUE),
      tmax_mean = mean(tmax, na.rm = TRUE),
      srad_mean = mean(srad, na.rm = TRUE),
      prcp_sum = sum(prcp, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(tavg_mean = (tmin_mean + tmax_mean) / 2)
  all_results[[batch_idx]] <- batch_result
}
all_points_length_re <- bind_rows(all_results)



saveRDS(all_points_length_re, "~/phenology-urban/data/proc/urban/NY/prelenth_urban_daymet.rds")
```

### Define the optimal preseason length

#### Urban

```{r}

all_points_length_re <- readRDS( "~/phenology-urban/data/proc/urban/NY/prelenth_urban_daymet.rds") %>%
  left_join(urban_tree_sos, by = c("id","year")) %>%
  select(id, srad_mean, prcp_sum, tavg_mean, preseason_length, year, lat, lon, taxa, doy)

all_years <- unique(all_points_length_re$year)
all_results <- list()
all_results <- lapply(all_years, function(year) {
  pre_lengths <- seq(5, 180, by = 5)
  results <- lapply(pre_lengths, function(prelen) {
    selected_data <- all_points_length_re %>%
      filter(preseason_length == !!prelen & year == !!year) 
    
    cal_data <- selected_data %>%
      dplyr::select(
        srad_mean, prcp_sum, tavg_mean, doy
      ) %>%
      na.omit()
    
    # Use tryCatch to handle errors in pcor()
    tryCatch({
      partial_corr <- pcor(cal_data)
      
      correlation <- partial_corr$estimate[
        rownames(partial_corr$estimate) == "doy", 
        colnames(partial_corr$estimate) == "tavg_mean"
      ]
      pvalue <- partial_corr$p.value[
        rownames(partial_corr$p.value) == "doy", 
        colnames(partial_corr$p.value) == "tavg_mean"
      ]
      
      list(correlation = correlation, pvalue = pvalue, selected_data = selected_data)
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Error with pre_length:", prelen, " - Skipping this pre_length.\n")
      list(correlation = NA, pvalue = NA, selected_data = NA)
    })
  })
  
  # Remove results with NA correlations
  results <- results[!sapply(results, function(x) is.null(x$correlation) || is.na(x$correlation))]
  
  correlations <- sapply(results, function(x) (x$correlation))
  pvalues <- sapply(results, function(x) (x$pvalue))
  
  if(all(sapply(correlations, is.null))){
    message("Skipping this due to empty correlation matrices.")
    corr <- list(
      optimal_pre_length = NA,
      pre_length_candidate = NULL,
      pre_length_trend = NULL,
      pvalue_trend = NULL,
      partial_correlation = NULL,
      partial_corr_pvalue = NULL,
      selected_data = NULL
    )
  }
  
  max_idx <- which.max(abs(correlations))
  corr <- list(
    optimal_pre_length = pre_lengths[max_idx],
    pre_length_candidate  = pre_lengths,
    pre_length_trend = correlations,
    pvalue_trend = pvalues,
    partial_correlation = results[[max_idx]]$correlation,
    partial_corr_pvalue = results[[max_idx]]$pvalue,
    selected_data = results[[max_idx]]$selected_data
  )
})

urban_date_preseason_var <- do.call(rbind, lapply(all_results, function(x) x$selected_data))
urban_date_combined_results <- lapply(all_results, function(x) {
  list(
    year = unique(x$selected_data$year),
    optimal_pre_length = x$optimal_pre_length,
    partial_correlation = x$partial_correlation,
    partial_corr_pvalue = x$partial_corr_pvalue,
    pre_length_candidate = x$pre_length_candidate,
    pre_length_trend = x$pre_length_trend,
    pvalue_trend = x$pvalue_trend
  )
})


# Function to check if a list element is effectively empty
is_empty <- function(x) {
  all(sapply(x, function(field) is.null(field) || all(is.na(field))))
}
urban_date_combined_results <- urban_date_combined_results[!sapply(urban_date_combined_results, is_empty)]
urban_date_combined_results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(urban_date_combined_results, as.data.frame))

saveRDS(urban_date_preseason_var, paste0("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/urban/NY/daymet_tavg_urban_var.rds"))
saveRDS(urban_date_combined_results, paste0("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/urban/NY/daymet_tavg_urban_pcorr.rds"))
```

### Compare sensitivity
```{r}
######## Fitting data

boundary <- st_read("~/urban-cooling/data/raw/WU/NY/Untitled/nybb_dissolved.shp")

urban_date_preseason_var <- readRDS("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/urban/NY/daymet_tavg_urban_var.rds") %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs = st_crs(boundary)) %>%
  mutate(lon = st_coordinates(.)[,1], lat = st_coordinates(.)[,2],
         year = as.factor(year)) 

tavg_allyear_var <- urban_date_preseason_var%>% 
  st_drop_geometry()

######### Prediction data ##############################

metadata <- read_csv("~/lab-data/datasets/vegetation/PS/urban/metadata.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(site == "NY")

file_list <- list.files(path = "~/lab-data/datasets/vegetation/PS/urban/doy", pattern = paste0("^doy_NY_Acer"), full.names = TRUE)

data_list <- file_list %>%
  map(~ readRDS(.x))
all_doy <- bind_rows(data_list)

urban_tree_ph <- metadata %>%
  mutate(genus = str_extract(taxa, "^[^ ]+")) %>%
  left_join(all_doy, by = "id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(doy))

urban_tree_sos <- urban_tree_ph %>%
  filter(direction == "up" & thres == 0.5 & genus =="Acer" & year == 2023) %>%
  summarise(doy = mean(doy)) %>%
  pull(doy)

preseason <- readRDS(paste0("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/urban/NY/daymet_tavg_urban_pcorr.rds")) %>%
  filter(year == 2023) %>%
  summarise(pre = mean(optimal_pre_length)) %>%
  pull(pre)

start_date = make_date(2023) + days(round(urban_tree_sos) - 1) - days(preseason)
end_date = make_date(2023) + days(round(urban_tree_sos) - 1)


folder.raw <- paste0("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/Daymet/daily2016-2024")
prediction <- data.frame()
file_list <- list.files(folder.raw, pattern = "_daily_2023_ncss\\.nc$", full.names = TRUE)
for (file in file_list) {
  clim_nc <- terra::rast(file)
  target_crs <- terra::crs(boundary)
  clim_nc <- terra::project(clim_nc, target_crs, method = "bilinear") 
  df_values <- as.data.frame(clim_nc, xy = TRUE)
  type <- sub("(.*?)_daily_2023_ncss\\.nc", "\\1", basename(file))
  if (type == "prcp") {
    df_values <- df_values %>%
      mutate(
        Sum_sum_mm = rowSums(across(3:112))) %>%
      select(x, y, Sum_sum_mm)
  }else{
    df_values <- df_values %>%
      mutate(
        !!type := rowMeans(across(3:112)))%>%
      select(x, y, !!type)
  }
  if (nrow(prediction) > 0) {
      prediction <- left_join(prediction, df_values, by = c("x", "y"))  # Merge with existing `perdiction`
    } else {
      prediction <- df_values  # Assign directly if `perdiction` is empty
    }
}

prediction <- prediction %>%
  mutate(AvgTemp_mean = (tmin + tmax)/2,
         Sum_mm_sum = ifelse(is.na(Sum_sum_mm), 0, Sum_sum_mm),
         srad_mean = ifelse(is.na(srad), 0, srad),
         year = 2023) %>%
  select(x, y, AvgTemp_mean, Sum_mm_sum, srad_mean, year)
  
prediction$year <- as.factor(prediction$year)
### Build the mesh 
coord <- cbind(tavg_allyear_var$lon, tavg_allyear_var$lat) # coordinates of observations
domain <- inla.nonconvex.hull(as.matrix(coord),
                              concave = -.07,convex = -0.05, resolution=c(100,100))

mesh <- inla.mesh.2d(boundary = domain, loc = coord,
                     max.edge = c(10000, 20000), 
                     cutoff = 1000 # prevent close points from being connected
)
# mesh$n
# ggplot() +
#   geom_sf(data=boundary,color='turquoise',fill='transparent') +
#   gg(mesh) +
#   geom_sf(data=urban_date_preseason_var,col='purple',size=1.7,alpha=0.5)

### Build the spde 

spde <- inla.spde2.matern(mesh = mesh, alpha = 2, constr = TRUE)
A.phe <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh = mesh, loc = coord)
s.index <- inla.spde.make.index(name = "spatial.field",
                                n.spde = spde$n.spde)
# dim(A.phe.p)

coorp <- cbind(prediction$x, prediction$y) 
A.phe.p <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh = mesh, loc = coorp)

######################################## Stack the data ########################################

stk.e <- inla.stack(
  tag = "est",
  data = list(y = tavg_allyear_var$doy),
  A = list(1, A.phe),
  effects = list(data.frame(Intercept = rep(1, nrow(coord)),
                            AvgTemp_mean = tavg_allyear_var$tavg_mean,
                            Sum_mm_sum = tavg_allyear_var$prcp_sum,
                            srad_mean = tavg_allyear_var$srad_mean,
                            year = tavg_allyear_var$year), 
                 s = s.index)
)


stk.p <- inla.stack(
  tag = "pred",
  data = list(y = NA),
  A = list(1, A.phe.p),
  effects = list(data.frame(Intercept = rep(1, nrow(coorp)),
                            AvgTemp_mean = prediction$AvgTemp_mean,
                            Sum_mm_sum = prediction$Sum_mm_sum,
                            srad_mean = prediction$srad_mean,
                            year = prediction$year), 
                 s = s.index)
)

# stk.full has stk.e and stk.p
stk.full <- inla.stack(stk.e, stk.p)

######################################## Run/Save the model ########################################

### Run the model
formula <- y ~ 0 + Intercept + AvgTemp_mean + Sum_mm_sum + srad_mean + f(year, model = 'iid') + f(spatial.field, model = spde)

res <- inla(formula,
            family = "gaussian",
            data = inla.stack.data(stk.full),
            control.compute = list(return.marginals = TRUE, waic = TRUE),
            control.predictor = list(
              compute = TRUE,
              A = inla.stack.A(stk.full)
            )
)
# res$waic$waic
# summary(res)

fix_effect <- as.data.frame(summary(res)$fixed)%>%
  rename(Estimate = mean,Lower = `0.025quant`,Upper = `0.975quant`) %>%
  mutate(Sig = ifelse(Lower*Upper>0, "*", "")) 
fix_effect <- data.frame(
  Factor = rownames(fix_effect),  # Add Factor column
  fix_effect, 
  row.names = NULL  # Remove row names to avoid duplication
) %>%
  filter(Factor == "AvgTemp_mean") %>%
  mutate(Factor = ifelse(Factor == "AvgTemp_mean", genus, Factor))

list(mesh = mesh,
     res = res,
     spde = spde,
     stk.full = stk.full,
     fix_effect = fix_effect) %>%
  saveRDS(paste0(r_output_dir, city, "_", genus, "_tavg_", phe_type, ".rds"))
```
